description: A multi-year campus-level smart meter database is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Mingchen Li et al. With the growing need for precise campus electricity management, understanding load patterns can guide efforts to improve energy efficiency and optimize energy use. However, detailed electricity load data for campus buildings and their internal equipment is often lacking, hindering research. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2024. Formats: Excel, Image. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1432485068 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
